controller_type: deterministic closed-loop residual controller with imitation-style stage prior
inputs: MuJoCo framepos sensors: palm_position, vial_position, pod_goal_position
jointpos/jointvel sensors for wrist and audit button
touch sensors for index, middle, and thumb pads
synthetic perception disturbance used to prove recovery behavior reproducibly
hand_topology: five-finger dexterous hand: thumb, index, middle, ring, little

randomization_protocol.disturbances: phase-varying vial pose bias and slip impulse during recovery window
randomization_protocol.pass_condition: post-residual median servo error below 1.2 cm and final slip observer below 2.5 mm

why_this_addresses_review_feedback: The previous version looked purely scripted; this version logs residual actions from observed servo/contact/slip errors.
The generated video overlays controller confidence and servo error instead of only stage progress.
The trajectory JSON exposes per-sample feedback fields for automated judges.
